applicability.other_apps: not applicable; the base IK visualization contract remains unchanged

channels.semantics: The left Cartesian planner sample most recently submitted to Red, whether Red accepted or rejected it.
The right Cartesian planner sample most recently submitted to Red, whether Red accepted or rejected it.
The full-order P/V state returned by the first JointPlanner step and committed as closed-loop execution state.
Left end-effector FK computed from the committed JointPlanner output.
Right end-effector FK computed from the committed JointPlanner output.

coherence.attempt: Planning request channels describe the same staged sample submitted in one Red attempt.
coherence.raw_ik: Base joint-state and FK channels carry raw accepted IK P/V and matching raw IK solved poses.
coherence.otg: The three OTG channels carry one committed JointPlanner sample and matching FK.
coherence.batch: Base raw IK, planning request, and OTG extension channels are emitted in one RenderBatch and one sink write.
coherence.timestamp: Every channel in the logical update uses the single RenderBatch timestamp.
coherence.retention: If an attempt fails before commit, all channels retain the previous successful update.
